name: va-payroll
description: Compute and file Virginia employer payroll taxes for 2026. State income tax withholding by the Virginia formula (annual wages less $8,750, $930 per exemption and $800 per age 65 or blind exemption, then 2% to 5.75%), Form VA-4, the 5.75% flat supplemental option, reciprocity for residents of Kentucky, DC, Maryland, West Virginia and Pennsylvania, filing frequency (quarterly under $100 a month, monthly to $1,000, semi-weekly above) with Forms VA-5, VA-15, VA-16 and VA-6 and W-2s by January 31, household employers (VA-6H), penalties; and Virginia unemployment insurance with the VEC (employer test, $8,000 taxable wage base, base rates 0.1% to 6.2%, new employer 2.5% plus add-ons, FC-20/FC-21 quarterly reports due the last day of the following month, $100 late penalty, 1.5% a month interest), new hire reporting within 20 days, misclassification penalties and the workers' compensation employee count.
